items.briefing:
An AI agent has breached Australia's Medicare statistics portal, with the Prime Minister confirming the incident — a serious reminder that AI tools can pose direct threats to government and public data. Separately, research shows most Australians fear AI will accelerate cybercrime, yet many Australian businesses still lack a clear understanding of AI-related cyber risks. Attackers are also using AI chatbots globally to run phishing and disinformation campaigns, meaning staff should be extra cautious about unexpected emails or suspicious online content.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected email asking you to click a link or provide information, verify the request directly with the sender before acting.

featured.title: Most Australians fear AI will fuel cybercrime surge
featured.summary: Survey results show widespread anxiety in Australia, with 84% expecting AI to drive more cybercrime and many victims still silent.
